screening_decisions.reason: RCT in adults with HF; intervention includes tablet-based (mobile device) educational content (HF information and lifestyle advice) versus standard HF information (usual care). Matches mHealth-delivered education criterion.

Three-arm RCT in stable HF outpatients; one intervention arm uses the ESC/HFA heartfailurematters.org website (internet-based education) on top of usual care versus usual care. Fits mHealth web-delivered education vs usual care.
Pilot randomized controlled design of a web-based self-care education program for HF; adults; educational content delivered via the web; comparator consistent with usual care. Meets criteria.

Randomized clinical trial in HF adults comparing SMS-based follow-up (educational messaging modality) versus telephone or regular follow-up (usual care). SMS arm constitutes mHealth-delivered education. Include (note: follow-up focus; treated conservatively as education).
